Legacy Tx Plan ID: the number of one of a patient's (alternative) plans. Blank = every plan of the selected patients, each printed as its own 'Treatment Plan : <n>' section. DentC plan ids are global strings (treatment_plans.id); the per-patient number the treatment-plan screen shows is computed client-side by assignTids() in src/features/treatment-plans/txModel.ts (1, 2, 3 by created_at, id). The report needs the same number on the server: NEW column rpt_treatment_item_facts.plan_no = row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY created_at, id) of treatment_plans (owner 03_data_foundation.md), so screen and report agree; a hard-deleted plan renumbers the later plans in both. The box accepts a plan_no (integer, applied to every selected patient). Inferred that the legacy number is per patient - confirm on the live tool with a two-patient batch.

Legacy Phase ID = rpt_treatment_item_facts.phase_id (integer). Blank = all phases of the plan print (vendor training PDF, partly legible). Validation: digits only. Echoed on the staff cover page only (NEW label 'Phase').

Legacy Order ID = priority within a phase = rpt_treatment_item_facts.priority (integer). Blank = every order id. Batch screen only (not on the single-patient dialog); meaning inferred from the vendor field definition - confirm on the live tool.

Which Financial Disclosure letter prints at the end of each document (merge fields such as tooth numbers resolved per patient). Option source financial_disclosure_letters: letter templates of the disclosure type assigned to the working office (office_letter_templates), alphabetical; default first_option = the first name in that order (vendor tip: prefix the name with a period). Which letter_type holds disclosures in DentC is open (04 option-source note). An office with no disclosure letter: the document prints without a disclosure block.

Exclude filter on the document's patient: patients having any selected user-defined type (rpt_patient_dim.patient_type_codes) get no document; None = exclude nothing; patients without a type are kept unless the source row no_type_defined is picked, which drops them (shared dictionary 3.4). Echoed on the staff cover page only (label Exclude Pat Type).

Ticked (legacy default) adds the UCR column to the procedure grid and to the phase and plan totals. Legacy UCR = the higher of the office UCR fee and the insurance fee-schedule fee (vendor text); DentC prints NEW computed ucr_display = greatest(coalesce(ucr_fee, fee), fee): ucr_fee is the stamped office UCR schedule price (NULL on migrated items and on items priced before the stamp), fee the fee-schedule fee posted on the item; the higher of the two, as the vendor text says - confirm on the live tool with an item whose insurance fee exceeds the office UCR. Layout switch, role query (adds a column).

Ticked (legacy default) prints per-procedure amounts (Est Pat., Est Ins., Fee, UCR on every line); unticked prints the procedure lines without amounts and only the phase and plan totals. Effect INFERRED (vendor sources do not describe it) - confirm on the live tool.

Unticked (legacy default) leaves out procedures already completed (rpt_treatment_item_facts.is_completed = a live charge is linked to the item); ticked prints them too, marked completed. No other status is filtered by the batch screen; the single-patient dialog defaults to Diagnosed + Accepted - whether the batch screen also leaves out Unaccepted / Hold / Alternative / Referred Out items is open (confirm on the live tool).

Ticked prints the responsible party's mailing address under 'Resp. Party :' in the header box (rpt_account_dim guarantor address of the patient's current account); unticked prints the name only (inferred).

legacy_corrections.text: DIAGNOSED DATE RANGE (Start Date / End Date) filters on the diagnosed date of the planned procedures: the date range in which the procedures were entered into the treatment plan (the diagnosed date defaults to the entry date and can be back-dated).
TREATMENT PLAN ID limits the print to one treatment plan (vendor training PDF on the treatment-plan print; its text was only partly legible).
PHASE ID limits the print to one phase; left blank, all phases of the plan print (vendor training PDF on the treatment-plan print; its text was only partly legible).

The FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE dropdown lists the letters of type `Financial Disclosure` that are assigned to the office (`Setup > Offices > Office Assignment > Letters`) - office data, not a fixed value list. The leading period of the captured value is a vendor-recommended sort trick, not a system value.

The selection decides which disclosure letter prints. The list is alphabetical, and the vendor's tip is to prefix a letter's name with a period so that it becomes the default - which is why the captured default starts with a period.

Two-layer legacy status (03 section 3.2 table). Exclusive statuses bind to rpt_treatment_item_facts.exclusive_status independent of the Scheduled / Completed flags: diagnosed, accepted, unaccepted, hold, alternative; referred_out = exclusive_status IN (referred_out, external_referral, internal_referral). Data-imposed change: legacy Internal / External Referral are additive flags on top of an exclusive status (research), DentC stores them as the single item status, so a DentC IR / ER item matches Referred Out and not its former exclusive status - confirm on the live tool with an item flagged External Referral. scheduled = is_scheduled, completed = is_completed, pre_authorized_sent / pre_authorized_closed = preauth_status sent / closed (primary pre-auth row). ALL = no status predicate. Accepted also matches items with exclusive_status_inferred = true (printed A*); the run returns an availability[] warning treatment_item_status_inferred with their count. Never bound to status_norm. Footer echo 'Tx Plan'.

Exclude filter: an item is dropped when it matches ANY picked status under the same predicates as TREATMENT PLANS (exclusive status, S / C flags, PS / PC pre-auth). None = exclude nothing. Option source treatment_plan_statuses: the ten legacy values (Accepted (A) and Alternative (L) INFERRED: above the visible part of the captured dialog) plus internal_referral, external_referral (enhancement: they pick the DentC item statuses that hold the legacy IR / ER flags; NEW echo letters IR, ER). An Accepted exclusion also drops inferred A* items. Footer echo prints the legacy letters ('Exclude Tx Plan : S,C'). Vendor recipe 'exclude Scheduled and Completed' = the unscheduled-treatment call list.

Include filter on the planned procedure code (rpt_treatment_item_facts.procedure_code IN list); ALL = no restriction. Legacy SEARCH CODE dialog (category radios, sort by code / description, transfer list) becomes the code picker with category tree (FLT-25).

Treatment counselor of the planned procedure = rpt_treatment_item_facts.counselor_user_id (a user, option source users, id and label only). ALL = no restriction; items without a counselor (every migrated item, and app items where none was chosen) match only ALL. Meaning from our transcription; the vendor documents the field, not the criterion.

Exclude filter on the patient's user-defined types (rpt_patient_dim.patient_type_codes); None = exclude nothing; patients without a type kept unless the source row no_type_defined is picked, which drops them (shared dictionary 3.4). Footer echo Exclude Pat Type (vendor sample).
Unticked (default) = only items of active patients (rpt_patient_dim.is_active); ticked adds inactive patients. Inactive and deleted patients share the flag until DATA-44.

Ticked adds a column with the system's internal plan identifier (treatment_plans.id) beside T ID; unticked prints only the per-patient plan number. Effect INFERRED (not documented) - confirm on the live tool.

legacy_corrections.text: Not truncated. A full-height vendor screenshot of this criteria screen shows exactly the two OTHER OPTIONS we transcribed (Include Inactive Patients, Include internal plan id) with blank space below: no further option row exists and the criteria panel is complete.

DIAGNOSED DATE RANGE (Start Date / End Date) filters on the diagnosed date of the planned procedures: the date range in which the procedures were entered into the treatment plan (the diagnosed date defaults to the entry date and can be back-dated).

Six of the ten statuses are exclusive: each planned procedure has exactly one of Diagnosed (D, the default when a procedure is entered), Accepted (A), Unaccepted (U), Hold (H), Alternative (L) or Referred Out (R).

The other four statuses are a second layer: Scheduled (S) and Completed (C) are additive flags and Pre-Authorized Sent (PS) / Pre-Authorized Closed (PC) are the pre-auth status, so a procedure can carry them on top of its exclusive status.
The radio limits the report to the procedures in the chosen status (ALL = no status filter). The vendor's sample echoes the choice in its footer as `Tx Plan`.

Vendor recipe that uses the status radio together with the exclusion picker: choose Accepted here and exclude Completed and / or Scheduled in EXCLUDE TREATMENT PLANS. It only works if staff actually mark plans Accepted.
EXCLUDE TREATMENT PLANS is a multi-select: the procedures in the picked statuses are removed from the report. The vendor sample echoes the picked status codes in its footer (`Exclude Tx Plan : S,C`).
Vendor recipe for the list of unscheduled / uncompleted treatment: exclude Scheduled and Completed to get everything not yet scheduled or done.
CODES limits the report to the picked procedure codes; SELECT opens the SEARCH CODE dialog (see the picker file).

TX COUNSELOR = treatment counselor, a field the vendor's treatment-plan screen keeps on each planned procedure. The picker is read as limiting the report to the procedures of the picked treatment counselor(s); that reading comes from our transcription - the vendor documents the field, not this criterion.
EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE removes the patients of the picked patient types from the report; the vendor's sample of this report echoes the choice in its footer as `Exclude Pat Type`.
